name: Enchant Arrow
body:
You may transfer spell energy to an arrow or bolt, creating a temporary magical weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast arcane or divine spells

Benefit: As a swift action you may enchant a readied arrow or loaded crossbow bolt. One prepared spell is immediately lost and the arrow or bolt gains an enchantment bonus equal to the level of the lost spell +1 (limit +5). The arrow or bolt is treated as magical ammunition for all intents and purposes.
